name: documint
description: Create interactive DocuMint HTML from source-grounded JSON with bundled original UI assets; no DocuMint CLI, MCP or server.

interface.longDescription: Generate an offline interactive DocuMint project map from repository files you can access. Uses the original Local HTML viewer styles and browser JavaScript packaged with the skill; AI-assisted source facts and coverage are shown transparently. No DocuMint server or Node CLI required for rendering.
defaultPrompt: Use DocuMint to create an interactive HTML project map for this accessible repository.
Document these source files with DocuMint and show evidence coverage.
Explain this codebase with a DocuMint offline architecture explorer.

publication.release_notes: DocuMint embedded interactive HTML v0.3.0: original project-map UI assets and browser renderer bundled with the Skill; structured AI-assisted source facts, coverage labeling and offline HTML generation. No MCP server or DocuMint CLI.
